question: Does invoking the same certified polynomial routine on genuinely partial contiguous prefixes alter CaDiCaL search on the fixed finite coordinate encodings, while preserving complete projected solution sets?

claims.text: Every learned prefix has a checked multiplier identity; every model is verified. Every declared complete result equals the independently certified complementary-point reference on all 12 fixed inputs and four encodings. Censored remains censored.
claims.if_not_supported: Retain counterexample and invalidate affected comparison; no closure.

claims.text: Within each fixed encoding/input, compare complete-model callback counts and genuine partial-prefix refutations between model_only and partial_prefix. A joint signature is at least one true partial proof with fewer model checks in an eligible complete matched pair.
claims.if_supported: After independent review, rank a separately admitted larger/held-out search comparison; no speedup or generalization.
claims.if_not_supported: Rerank only this fixed callback schedule/window; no SAT or ECDLP closure.

claims.text: Retain all named primitive/event counters and paired differences, separately by phase and unit. These cover an instrumented subset and are not total work or runtime.
General ECDLP recovery, total-cost/runtime advantage, intrinsic regularity, novelty, arbitrary trail clauses and shared-coefficient improvement are not tested.

stopping_rules.rule: One serial run:144 ordinary search executions,9 solver controls and12 references; no outcome-selected targets/scaling or automatic reruns.

PC caps degree2/256 admitted rows/512 calls; rows+1 attempted marker retained. PC exhaustion disables PC only; checked constant-inverse leaf fallback remains. Native20k decisions and20k conflicts per solve, at most2^(2s)+1 solves; budget None result is censored.

Child120s or global7200s watchdog retains partials; absent required final artifacts makes native aggregate incomplete/invalid, never negative mathematics. Controls must complete; censored A/A is inconclusive.

invalidation_rules: Wrong source/config/native ABI, invalid identity/model/reference, reference-guided search, missing/duplicate/unplanned row, changed callback/backend policy, false partial label, failed required control, complete A/A mismatch or omitted costs invalidates the affected observation.
A native-budget censored full-output row is retained and nondecisive; process timeout missing final artifacts prevents valid aggregate completion.

decision_rule.text: C-SOUND requires valid finite identities/witnesses/completeness and required controls. For C-SEARCH, an eligible pair needs native validity, both complete matched searches and complete identical candidate A/A. Report at least one genuine partial proof plus fewer model_checks as a mechanism signature. Report all48 pairs; any ineligible pair makes the full-inventory decision inconclusive. A complete inventory with zero signatures is negative only for this schedule/window. No claim of full cost/runtime reduction.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-pair exact model_checks difference and count of genuinely partial proofs; retain all separate recorded-vector differences.
decision_rule.interval: None; fixed deterministic inventory, A/A exact equality on complete pairs.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Signed integer differences in the same counter and phase; no pooled ratio, significance or mixed-unit scalar cost.
